sql.query:
SELECT 'user'             AS token, '$env:user$'             AS value
  UNION ALL SELECT 'user_realname',   '$env:user_realname$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'device',          '$env:device$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'platform',        '$env:platform$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'idiom',           '$env:idiom$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'os_version',      '$env:os_version$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'device_model',    '$env:device_model$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'app',             '$env:app$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'version',         '$env:version$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dashboard',       '$env:dashboard$'
  -- appearance / geometry (live)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'appearance',      '$env:appearance$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'orientation',     '$env:orientation$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'window_w x h',    '$env:window_width$' || ' x ' || '$env:window_height$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'size_class',      '$env:size_class$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'scale',           '$env:scale$'
  -- locale / formatting
  UNION ALL SELECT 'locale',          '$env:locale$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'language',        '$env:language$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'region',          '$env:region$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'currency',        '$env:currency$' || ' (' || '$env:currency_symbol$' ||
  ')'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'measurement',     '$env:measurement_system$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'temperature',     '$env:temperature_unit$'
  UNION ALL SELECT '24h clock',       '$env:uses_24h$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'first_weekday',   '$env:first_weekday$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'calendar',        '$env:calendar$'
  -- time (ticks each minute)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'date',            '$env:date$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'time',            '$env:time$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'hour',            '$env:hour$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'weekday',         '$env:weekday$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'is_weekend',      '$env:is_weekend$'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'timezone',        '$env:timezone$';
